name: @w6w-apps/msg91
description: Send SMS, OTPs, email and WhatsApp messages and read delivery reports through MSG91.

w6w.longDescription:
MSG91 is an Indian cloud-communications platform (CPaaS) for transactional and marketing messaging. This app drives its v5 API from a workflow.

SMS goes out through DLT-approved templates (flows) to one or many numbers with per-recipient variables. One-time passwords can be sent, verified and resent by text or voice, with the verify step returning a plain true/false instead of an error when the code is wrong or expired. Email sends from a template through a verified domain with cc, bcc, reply-to, variables and attachments, and any address can be checked for deliverability, disposable domains and role addresses.

On WhatsApp it sends approved templates to one or many recipients, sends in-session text replies, and lists the integrated numbers, a number's templates and its prepaid balance. Delivery logs (OTP, email, WhatsApp; three-day windows) and SMS analytics (31 days) close the loop.

Voice, RCS, Segmento contacts, campaigns, the Hello inbox, sub-accounts, template creation, the OTP widget and OneAPI flows are not part of this app.
